policies: Do not update or replace v3.6 images, CSS or active binding routes.
Reserved icons are assets supplied by the user, not permission to use a mismatched image as a final HIGHFLY item.
All new UI bindings remain DISABLED until artwork is visually approved and game behavior is integrated.
Material colors in icon art do not assign ingot/ore inventory identity.
All new gear +0; no auto-enchantment or bonus from rarity interpreted as +N.
Armor/necklaces/rings never modify avatar mesh during P4.
Never publish KayKit SOURCE or restricted ClaudeCraft/Emberfall media.
These icon paths are proposals: archive contents are checked by CI; pixel-by-pixel visual identity must be reviewed by a human.
